title: Patronage
summary: Patronage involved relationships of benefaction, obligation, honor, and dependence between givers and recipients.
background: In the Greco-Roman world, patrons gave benefits and clients returned loyalty, honor, and service. This background helps clarify grace language by contrast and context.
teachingHelp: Use patronage carefully: God’s grace is not a manipulative social transaction, but the background helps explain honor, obligation, and gift language.
